facts.label: In English
facts.value: French bivouac before the main gate, 6-9 October 1860

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a place outside the walls outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: French troops camped here from the evening of 6 Oct 1860 (S241 p.293; S245 p.227)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: text: the tree-planted square before the gate between two lakes (S241 p.293 'between two large pieces of water in front of the grand entrance ... It was here under the trees that the French were encamped'); placed on the forecourt south of 大宫门 by the 扇面湖 (repo YM41-13), C

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Varin S245 p.227: 'une vaste place plantée de grands arbres, bornée sur un de ses côtés par un lac'; chevaux de frise at its entrance; a guard post of about ten men with bows and matchlocks before the gate withdrew. Grant S243 p.128: 'the French had encamped near the entrance of the Great Audience Hall'.

sources.text: Robert Swinhoe, Narrative of the North China Campaign of 1860, London: Smith, Elder, 1861
